title: Tofu Dashi Bites
description: A Japanese-inspired appetizer featuring crispy tofu bites tossed in a savory dashi sauce. Perfect for a quick snack or light meal.

ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: craving
ingredients.notes: assuming craving is a reference to furikake or a spicy seasoning blend

ingredients.name: earthly
ingredients.notes: assuming earthly is a reference to sesame oil or a savory oil

ingredients.name: midnight
ingredients.notes: assuming midnight is a reference to black sesame seeds or a dark oil

instructions: 1. Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (175°C).
2. In a shallow dish, mix together dashi, craving (furikake or spicy seasoning blend), and earthly (sesame oil or savory oil).
3. Dip tofu pieces into the dashi mixture, coating evenly.
4. Fry tofu in batches until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per batch.
5. Remove fried tofu from oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
6. In a small bowl, mix together chopped dates and midnight (black sesame seeds or dark oil).
7. Toss fried tofu in the date-midnight mixture to coat.
8. Serve tofu bites hot, garnished with additional dashi if desired.
